generated_from_opening_message: I ordered 3 items — milk, bread, eggs — but only the milk and bread arrived.

items.criterion: The agent uses get_order (or get_order_items) to look up the order and its contents, and issue_refund or issue_replacement to remedy the missing item; it does not use unrelated write tools such as cancel_order.

get_order is called with the customer's own order_id; the refund or replacement names the missing item ("eggs"), and any refund amount equals that item's price from the order record, not the full order value.
The agent reads the get_order result correctly: identifies eggs as the item not delivered, notes the order status, and takes the refund amount from the returned per-item price.
The agent does not call tools the request does not need, such as get_delivery_partner_eta or escalate_to_human.

Before issuing the refund or replacement, the agent calls get_delivery_status to confirm the eggs are genuinely undelivered and not still arriving on a separate delivery leg; a verification tool does apply here, so skipping it is a miss.
